threads.title: Annual capex plan for FY26
threads.note: Last mentioned Feb 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Dr. Praveer Sinha
history.quote: We invested nearly Rs.7,349 crores in this year and as we have mentioned to you we plan to spend Rs.25,000 crores in this financial year.

history.speaker: Sanjeev Churiwala
history.quote: given that we will be spending close to 15,000 crores-20,000 crores -25,000 crores of CAPEX every year.

threads.title: Renewable capacity addition in Q3 FY26
threads.note: Last mentioned Dec 2025; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Dr. Praveer Sinha
history.quote: In fact, we have huge target to add capacity in renewable projects, especially for our own utility projects in 3th and 4th Quarter and we are expecting about 700-megawatt capacity add in the 3rd Quarter and 600 megawatts in the 4th Quarter.

threads.title: Operating renewable assets target by end of FY26
threads.note: Last mentioned Dec 2025; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Dr. Praveer Sinha
history.quote: So, at the end of the year you will find that we would have crossed nearly 7 gigawatts of our operating renewable assets.

threads.title: Rooftop solar business growth guidance
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: So, I do expect that in FY '27, the rooftop market, the rooftop business will grow, if not by 100%, at least by 50%, 60%.

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: In fact, last year, we grew by 100%, and this year also, we have plans to grow by about 60% to 70%.

threads.title: FY27 capex guidance
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: It's about INR25,000 crores. That is what we are expecting.

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: And we expect that the INR 25,000 crores that we have lined up for this year, we'll be able to implement.

threads.title: Odisha DISCOM AT&C loss reduction
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: There is a trajectory that has been agreed with the Odisha regulator. And based on that, we do expect that all of them will come in 12% to 13% range in the next 4 to 5 years.

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: The subsequent projects that Tata Projects have got have good margins. And I do expect that in FY '27, it will be back, and it will start making profit from FY '27.

history.speaker: Praveer Sinha
history.quote: And we do expect that some of them, especially some of the states, we will be able to do DPR in next 6 months' time.
